description: This file contains static functions for printing and reporting test results in various protocols (CLAP and TAP) for the Clar testing framework. It handles initialization, shutdown, error reporting, test case reporting, and suite reporting with different verbosity levels and formats.

methods.name: void clar_print_clap_init(int test_count,int suite_count)
methods.description: Prints the initial output for the CLAP protocol, indicating number of loaded test suites.

methods.name: void clar_print_clap_shutdown(int test_count,int suite_count,int error_count)
methods.description: Prints the shutdown message and reports results for the CLAP protocol.

methods.name: void clar_print_indented(const char * str,int indent)
methods.description: Prints a string with specified indentation, handling multiline strings.

methods.name: void clar_print_clap_error(int num,const struct clar_report * report,const struct clar_error * error)
methods.description: Reports a test failure with detailed information.

methods.name: void clar_print_clap_ontest(const char * suite_name,const char * test_name,int test_number,enum cl_test_status status)
methods.description: Reports individual test case progress and outcomes for CLAP protocol.

methods.name: void clar_print_clap_onsuite(const char * suite_name,int suite_index)
methods.description: Reports the start of a test suite in CLAP protocol.

methods.name: void clar_print_clap_onabort(const char * fmt,va_list arg)
methods.description: Outputs an abort message for CLAP protocol.

methods.name: void clar_print_tap_init(int test_count,int suite_count)
methods.description: Initializes TAP output with the version number.

methods.name: void clar_print_tap_shutdown(int test_count,int suite_count,int error_count)
methods.description: Outputs the total number of tests run in TAP protocol.

methods.name: void clar_print_tap_error(int num,const struct clar_report * report,const struct clar_error * error)
methods.description: Stub function; no output implemented for TAP errors.

methods.name: void print_escaped(const char * str)
methods.description: Escapes single quotes in a string for TAP output.

methods.name: void clar_print_tap_ontest(const char * suite_name,const char * test_name,int test_number,enum cl_test_status status)
methods.description: Reports individual test results in TAP protocol, including detailed error info on failure.

methods.name: void clar_print_tap_onsuite(const char * suite_name,int suite_index)
methods.description: Reports the start of a test suite in TAP protocol.

methods.name: void clar_print_tap_onabort(const char * fmt,va_list arg)
methods.description: Outputs a bailout message in TAP protocol.

methods.name: void clar_print_onabortv(const char * msg,va_list argp)
methods.description: Outputs an abort message with formatted arguments.

methods.name: void clar_print_onabort(const char * msg,...)
methods.description: Variadic wrapper for clar_print_onabortv to output abort message.
